misc.about:
I'm Bariola, a ten-year-old calico cat.
My name comes from the word "bariolé" (French) which means "coloured in bright and varied tones".
The digital version of me was created by Antoine Després.
Check out his other creations and my source code on: https://github.com/antoinedespres !
